english.title: Cause / permit use of vehicle in dangerous condition / carry passengers / load to cause danger on Heathrow Airport
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), on part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments did not apply, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PART OF THE AIRPORT..),

(A)_[caused]_
(B)_[permitted]_

the use of a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in such a condition or manner that danger was caused or was likely to be caused to any person in or on the Airport, due to the

(C)_[condition of the vehicle's parts or accessories, namely **(..SPECIFY PART / ACCESSORY..)]_
(D)_[number of passengers carried by the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY NUMBER OF PASSENGERS..)]_
(E)_[manner in which passengers were carried by the vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY MANNER..)]_
(F)_[weight, distribution, packing or adjustment of the load of the vehicle]_
(G)_[**(..IF A COMBINATION OF THE ABOVE - SPECIFY..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 5.8(a) and 2.3 of the Heathrow Airport - London Byelaws, 2014 and section 63 of the Airports Act 1986.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
on part of Heathrow Airport to which the road traffic enactments do not apply
caused / permitted the use of a vehicle when it and all parts and accessories of it
were not in such a condition and the number of passengers carried by it
the manner in which they were carried in / on it and the weight / distribution / packing and adjustment of its load
were not such that no danger was caused / was likely to be caused
to any person in / on it / on the airport
